description_en: Queries the details of a specified instance by calling DescribeInstanceDetails
description_zh: 调用DescribeInstanceDetails查询指定实例的详情信息
name: DescribeInstanceDetails

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically obtains the value
parameters.help_zh: 请求源IP。无需填写，系统自动获取
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en: The instance IDs that you want to query. Specify the value as a JSON array of instance IDs. Exact match is supported. Example: `["ddoscoo-cn-XXXX1", "ddoscoo-cn-XXXX2"]`
parameters.help_zh: 通过实例Id查询实例信息，传入要查询的实例Id数组（JSON字符串）。支持精确匹配。例如，`["ddoscoo-cn-XXXX1", "ddoscoo-cn-XXXX2"]`
parameters.name: instance_ids
